'''Clue scroll (beginner)''' is an [[emote clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]].

The items can be stored in a [[STASH]] bush outside Aris' tent. It requires {{SCP|Construction|12|link=yes}}, a [[hammer]], [[saw]], 2 [[plank|planks]] and 10 [[Nails]] to build. Building the STASH rewards the player with 150 Construction XP.
